text: In response to Toronto and East York Community Council Item TE5.89, Transportation Services staff have reviewed the existing signal timing plans at the intersections of Pape Avenue at Danforth Avenue and Pape Avenue at Lipton Avenue. Our assessment has indicated that signal timing and hardware adjustments can be made at these signals to improve traffic operations and safety.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for information.
